title: Thunderbird mail profiles
whyItMatters: Thunderbird profiles hold local mail folders, account settings and address books. Their size shows how much correspondence remains on this machine.
notes: Each profile folder has a random name ending in .default-release. Mail folders and address books are counted only; no message is read.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy the mail folders you want to keep, and export address books from Thunderbird Address Book before removing the profiles.
steps: Open the Thunderbird profile manager and remove each profile listed there.
Delete the Thunderbird profile folders named in the plan if they are still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local mail, address books and account settings for every Thunderbird profile on this PC.
cleanup.source: Mozilla Support, Profile Manager - Create and remove Thunderbird profiles: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/profile-manager-create-and-remove-thunderbird-profiles
